data.exact_reserve_text: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $121m for Syndicate 2003 was experienced during the year driven from various lines of business. The most significant contributors towards the adverse experience were London Wholesale Property ($58m), Energy ($32m) and Workers' Compensation ($18m) accounts due to unfavourable claims experience.

named_events.loss_description: Collectively represented gross losses to the Syndicate of $1,015m. Net of all reinsurance and related reinstatement premiums, the total losses on these events was $290m.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2003 opened 2017 with gross claims outstanding of $4,143.479m (31-Dec-2016). During 2017 there was adverse prior-year development totalling $121.0m (approximately 2.92% of opening gross claims), described as an "unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration)". The principal contributors were London Wholesale Property ($58m), Energy ($32m) and US Workers' Compensation ($18m). Separately, 2017 catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the Mexico earthquake and California wildfires) produced significant gross losses (collective gross $1,015m) with net-of-reinsurance impact of $290m.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are presented in the report currency (USD). Original tables were in $'000s; figures converted to millions by dividing by 1,000. The prior year movement ($121m) is taken verbatim from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note. Page numbers are estimated based on the report's notes pagination. The claims development triangle contains an aggregated '2011 & Prior' column which was excluded per instructions.
